# Feature Specification

The feature specification deliverable (spec.md). Dense by construction, human-legible.
Follows the deliverable envelope (artifact-format.md). Omit empty sections. Section density
norms: Overview <= 3 lines; stories per authoring-user-stories (scenarios one line each, 2-3
per story); FR/SC/edge-case entries one line each; entities conceptual and compact.

## Intent

The confirmed one-screen synthesis from the intent stage — elicited rulings, one line
each, confirmed by the user before authoring began. Governs the authoring depth, the
feature derivation, and the stress-test rigor. Omit a line only if the probe was
genuinely not applicable. Lines: Scope boundary; Delivery (whole vs subset now, first
shippable value, sequencing constraints); Depth / rigor; UX-bearing (yes -> Screens &
Flows + prototype obligated; no -> the waiver line); Constraints; Out of scope.

_Density:_ one line per ruling

## Overview

A compact synthesis of what the feature is. No more than three lines.

_Density:_ <= 3 lines

## User Stories

An INDEX only, and the spec's slate. A header line above the table records the slate's
source (forks · handed in). The index holds one row per slate row ruled `in`, `in —
waiver pending` included; rows ruled `out` sit unlinked in the `### Struck candidates`
sub-table below it. Story content lives in per-story files, stories/US-*.md, authored
for rows ruled `in` only — each carries the story text, its acceptance scenarios, and
its FEAT-ID mapping. Columns: ID (linked to stories/US-N.md; unlinked while `in —
waiver pending`), Story (one breath, then its provenance mark, and for a narrowed row
the cut noted after the line), Priority (P1/P2/P3), Test (the user's seed, or `test:
open`), Feature (FEAT-XXX-<slug> or —), Disposition — before authoring the slate value
(`in` | `in — waiver pending`), after derivation `homed | rejected — why`; a struck
row's Disposition is `out — <why>`. The only story-native status is `rejected` (the
derivation filter's verdict, with the why, recorded in the story file); the slate
values are pre-authoring dispositions, not statuses; every other status is derived by
following the story's FEAT-ID to the feature map.

## Edge Cases

The boundary and failure conditions the feature must handle — one line each.

_Density:_ one line each

## Functional Requirements

Technology-agnostic functional requirements (FR-XXX-<slug>), one line each, per
authoring-requirements, each citing the story it serves (US-N-<slug>). RFC 2119
language.

_Density:_ one line each

## Key Entities

The feature's domain nouns — conceptual and compact, not an OpenAPI schema.

## Success Criteria

Measurable success criteria (SC-XXX-<slug>), one line each, per authoring-requirements.

_Density:_ one line each

## Screens & Flows

Authored per mochiko:authoring-prototype from the Intent section's UX-bearing ruling. Not
UX-bearing -> the single line "No UX surface — prototype waived at intent." and nothing
else. UX-bearing -> one Direction block per surface (per mochiko:patterns-design-direction), both
tables, and the prototype pointer, in full. The manifest is binding
(screens, data, actions); the prototype's pixels are advisory. Feature column lands at
derivation as a re-tag pass (FEAT-XXX-<slug> per row); screens of unselected features greyed
coming-soon; a filter-rejected story's screens kept, greyed, marked rejected.

Good example:
UX-bearing form:

### Direction — [surface] ([SCR range])
- **Mode:** [Persuade | Operate | Read | Experience]
- **Register:** [bolder | quieter | distill | held] — [why, one clause]
- **Contract:** thesis — [...] · own world — [...] · story — [...] · first viewport — [...] · viewports — [...]
- **Declared tokens (intent):** [type · color · spacing · motion, as intent] | none — honors the baseline
- **Incumbent world:** [preserve | expand | replace] — [evidence, one clause]

| ID | Screen | Purpose | Data shown | Feature |
|----|--------|---------|------------|---------|
| SCR-001-<slug> | [name] | [one line] | [fields/collections rendered] | FEAT-001-<slug> |

| ID | Flow | Steps | Story scenario | Feature |
|----|------|-------|----------------|---------|
| FLOW-001-<slug> | [name] | SCR-001-<slug> -> [action] -> SCR-002-<slug> | US-1-<slug> / [scenario] | FEAT-001-<slug> |

**Prototype:** `prototype/` — clickable low-fi rendering of this manifest; serve with bun
or open `prototype/index.html` directly. Flows and data are binding; layout and styling
advisory.

## Feature Selection

Authored per mochiko:authoring-feature-map after stories are drafted. Derivation output
(proposed entries, deltas, index-line drafts) stages in this spec workspace; the live map
is written only at spec acceptance, as one atomic batch. The selection itself is the
user's ruling — the derived table and filter verdicts are the producer's, the Selected
line records the user's choice. Three sub-parts: Derived features (table: FEAT-ID,
Feature, New/delta, Stories, SCs verified); Filter rejections (one line per rejected story
— the why verbatim from its story file; omit when none); Selection (Selected build-now in
dependency order; Deferred proposed entries carrying their SCs + seam obligations;
Deferred SCs — the ones covered only by unselected features, shown at the moment of
choice, never discovered at close).

## Assumptions — optional

Assumptions the specification rests on. Omit if empty.

## Open Questions — optional

Unresolved questions carried out of authoring. Omit if empty.

## Conformance

Checked mechanically before the write lands. Each line is a string or a count, never a judgment.

- Required headings, in order: `## Intent`, `## Overview`, `## User Stories`, `## Edge Cases`, `## Functional Requirements`, `## Key Entities`, `## Success Criteria`, `## Screens & Flows`, `## Feature Selection`
- An undeclared `##` heading is denied. `###` and deeper are yours.
- Line budgets, each counted from its `##` line to the next `##`, nested content included:
  - `## Intent` — 10 lines
  - `## Overview` — 6 lines
  - `## Key Entities` — 15 lines
  - `## Screens & Flows` — 44 lines
  - `## Feature Selection` — 20 lines
  - `## Assumptions` — 10 lines (optional)
  - `## Open Questions` — 10 lines (optional)
